description: Return the FULL website intake questionnaire (about 20 questions grouped by topic) so you can present them all at once and let the user answer in a single batch — or in batches of ~10 — instead of one question at a time. Ask the user which method they prefer first (all-at-once form, batches, or one-by-one). Only business name, type and country are required. Use this whenever a user prefers to fill in details up front rather than a back-and-forth.
name: get_intake_questions
